patch_description: Add an objective-aligned bin-packing initializer. For a target maximum KVPR `p`, a GPU is feasible exactly when each assigned model contributes `weight + p * size` within capacity `p * GPU_MEM_SIZE`. Best-fit packing under this transformed capacity directly targets the KVPR objective while respecting memory. Binary search finds increasingly lower successful thresholds, and every successful assignment is verified using the actual KVPR before becoming a local-search seed.
